name: copilotprompts-agent-topic-blueprint
title: Agent topic blueprint
shortDescription: Turns a one-line use case into a build-ready Microsoft Copilot Studio agent blueprint.
longDescription: This prompt turns a one-line use case into a build-ready Microsoft Copilot Studio agent blueprint. It returns an agent-type and orchestration recommendation, 3 to 7 topics with selection-friendly descriptions and node flows, tools and actions with typed inputs and failure paths, knowledge sources, global variables, a valid Adaptive Card welcome, security and Copilot Credits cost notes, and a first test plan. It gives a maker a concrete starting structure to implement in Copilot Studio instead of a blank canvas.
